brief: Goldy rejected the outlined wordmark and told me to stop treating the Figma board's coordinates as a spec. Frame 1280 to 1400, left gutter 63 to 110, rail 239 to 260. Wordmark set solid at 31px heading the left column, dropped 62px so it clears the portrait's head and sits on her darkened shoulder. Two frame-literal desyncs fixed in passing: .page had max-width 1280px while --frame said 1400, and the canvas kept its own var FRAME = 1280; both now read --frame. Side letterbox bands and the hard vertical moon clip both removed: the bands drew a visible black rectangle down each side, and they only existed to disguise the clip, which only existed because I cut the disc on a straight line. mistakes: Three self-inflicted in one pass: a blanket ctx->mctx rewrite also hit 'mctx.' and produced 'mmctx.', which killed the canvas entirely (caught on a screenshot, black page); an earlier regex left two img.sprite in the document; and the in-app preview pane served a stale snapshot for several measurement rounds, so geometry had to be read through headless Chrome --dump-dom instead.
corrections: Moon reverted to a single-canvas draw. 'Place the moon accordingly' was an instruction to move it; I rebuilt it onto a separate compositing layer with a feathered edge instead, and the feather left a visible vertical seam down the disc. Layer, feather and the whole detour removed; the moon draws exactly as it did before. Sprite swapped to ARU_A_07_00 (hand on hip, weight back).
